Scene 2: He removes or leaves behind symbols of the role.

Scene 3: He reaches beach/ocean and steps toward an authentic future.
vision.notes:

Visual style notes: Corporate gray to ocean color
Mood notes: Liberating, reflective

Ending: The hardest thing to let go of is the version of yourself built for other people.
